ees_schema.source: THEVERIDIC/VERIDIC standards/ees/v0.2/air.schema.json (Apache-2.0), pinned copy in vectors/
ees_schema.note: shape check with `integrity` excluded (the draft carries those members in the protected header); not a check of the draft

checks.check: COSE_Sign1 of four elements, protected header a byte string holding a map
alg (label 1) is ES256 (-7)
kid (label 4) present, a byte string
CWT Claims (label 15) present with iss (1) and sub (2), text strings
integrity fields present and typed: content_hash, prev_chain_hash, chain_hash (32-byte bstr), sequence_number, action_timestamp_ms (uint), agent_id (tstr)
header agent_id equals CWT sub
step 1, payload integrity: SHA-256(payload) equals content_hash
step 2, chain integrity: chain_hash recomputed from the header's content_hash, prev_chain_hash, action_timestamp_ms and agent_id with the 5.7 encoding
step 3, signature validity: ES256 over the RFC 9052 Sig_structure (Signature1, protected, empty external_aad, payload) with the operator's public key
step 4, sequence completeness: sequence_number is zero with a zero prev_chain_hash, or one more than the preceding record's with its chain_hash as prev_chain_hash
payload is a JSON object in RFC 8785 canonical form (re-serialisation gives the same bytes)
schema_version is "air-1.0"
every REQUIRED member present, non-null and of its CDDL type
every OPTIONAL member present (null when absent) and of its CDDL type when not null
no member outside the CDDL map
action_type valid: a Table 2 value, or a reverse-DNS namespaced value
outcome_state is one of completed, failed, partially_completed, reversed, pending_confirmation
retention_class is one of the five labels (informational labels, 5.3)
jurisdiction has the form of an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code
record_id is a UUID of version 7
session_id is a UUID
input_hash and outcome_hash decode to 32 bytes (base64url without padding, the EES v0.2 provisional encoding)
tool_calls items are ToolCallRecord {tool_id, tool_type, input_hash, output_hash, is_write, timestamp_ms}
external_refs items are ExternalRef {ref_type, ref_value, ref_system / null}
redaction_receipts items are RedactionReceipt {field_path, original_hash, policy_id, timestamp_ms}
auth_context, when present, is AuthContext {token_type, scopes, audience / null, expires_at_ms / null}
policy_refs and delegation_chain are arrays of text strings
payload agent_id equals the header's agent_id and the CWT sub
payload action_timestamp_ms equals the header's
payload operator_id equals CWT iss; operator_pubkey_id equals kid
action_timestamp_ms <= captured_timestamp_ms
at least one RedactionReceipt for the action types 6.4 names
